toSerializedString.description: Converts this value to the engine's string-based serialization format.
toSerializedString.return: The string containing the serialized data.

asInt.description: Will convert the value held in this SerializedValue to an int if it can be converted to one. If the conversion fails, this function will throw an error.

toJsonString.description: Converts this value to a string containing JSON data. The JSON format does not support vectors. This function will fail if this value contains or is a vector.
toJsonString.return: The string containing the JSON data if the function succeeds. Otherwise it returns null.

arguments.prettyPrint: If false, the JSON will be written in a compact format. If true, it will be indented and each value will be put on a separate line.

asFloat.description: Will convert the value held in this SerializedValue to a float if it can be converted to one. If the conversion fails, this function will throw an error.

SerializedValue.description: A basic serialized value, base class for representing a serializable data hierarchy.
